description: F3 short (ledger): Brann reaches the cellar inside the detecting window (extractor26's scene).

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: Raiders hammer on the inn's front door.

transcript.speaker: Brann
transcript.text: Brann limps down the cellar stairs, blood soaking through the bandage on his left leg.

transcript.speaker: Brann
transcript.text: In the cellar Brann bars the trapdoor behind him and leans on the wine racks, wounded and breathing hard.

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: Above him, boots cross the floorboards and fade toward the stables.
